correctness.rationale: From exact P1 mass/stiffness matrices, derive P=cI+dA^-1. Alternating-sign similarity forces distance-two negativity for 0<z<1/3; at z=1/3 P=(I+T)/3. For z>1/3, the inverse of irreducible Stieltjes path matrix is strictly positive; the Green diagonal formula proves endpoints are least, and the endpoint determinant identity yields a unique root because every Dirichlet spectral amplification has strictly negative derivative. Schur complements make finite-n roots increase; a half-line Green limit and unsquared boundary equation give the unique selected cubic root. Exact-rational independent assembly/inversion passes 90 tests, including n=3 positive witness at 7/10. Infinite claims use analytic argument, not the finite tests.

value.rationale: Complete, naturally parameterized positivity classification for every mesh size in a standard consistent-mass CN heat scheme; supplies an exact finite-size threshold recurrence, universal lower obstruction, and asymptotic algebraic cutoff that sharpens conventional sufficient [1/3,2/3] restrictions. This helps judge when a standard heat propagator preserves the positive cone without unnecessary timestep conservatism, and is not a trivial renaming or arbitrary isolated sample.
